source.verification: Native Excel full recalculation, disposable copies, save/reopen, independent revenue/cash/return checks

assumptions.returnBasis: Unlevered project cash; not an investor security, financing commitment or guaranteed return
assumptions.powerStrategy: Grid power at launch; solar and BESS are a separate future investment and are not included in these project returns
assumptions.supportCostBasis: Complete B300 system purchase subtotal, excluding separate storage/spares and freight/tax
assumptions.networkBudgetEvidence: The model uses a $48,000 annual connectivity allowance ($4,000/month). An earlier management-reported $8,075/month carrier option remains unconfirmed and its service scope must be reconciled with this allowance; neither amount is an accepted full-bandwidth quote.
assumptions.bcLlcBasis: Positive after-tax accounting income; no payment on losses
assumptions.founderCapitalEvidence: Owner reported; availability and commitment not independently verified
assumptions.hardwarePriceEvidence: Owner-reported $670,000 per complete eight-GPU node; final supplier quote, exact SKU and support terms require verification
assumptions.engineeringStatus: Preliminary planning estimates; utility service, voltage conversion, thermal derating, installed pricing and final design require professional/vendor confirmation
assumptions.cashTiming: Hardware and infrastructure funded at inception; annual operating distributions; final receivable separately dated after sale. This is not a complete monthly life-of-project liquidity forecast.
assumptions.resaleEvidence: Model assumption, not a guaranteed equipment buyback or independent valuation
assumptions.npvBasis: npvUsd is headline annual project NPV at the hurdle; datedFundedNpvUsd discounts the dated funded cash strip
